unresolved.paper: Aging Clocks, Entropy, and the Challenge of Age Reversal
unresolved.note: Methods says exclude below 20 (620 remain); Results says analyze older than 25. Reproduction must reconcile this.
Recovery-rate patterns are observational and extrapolated beyond observed ages. Prospective perturbations and alternative curvature remain untested here.

Age-selected cross-sectional methylation and longitudinal diagnosis patterns are compatible with a proposed model; they do not identify a unique microscopic cause or directly measure whole-organism thermodynamic entropy.
An unchanged signature is not an equivalence result. Reporting/one-sided testing issues and power should be resolved before treating intervention non-response as irreversible damage.
Methods supplement was located but not read, so resource completeness is unknown. No prospective blinded clinical cohort was evaluated by this review.

Liver-region samples are not automatically independent mice; sorted transfected-cell efficiencies do not imply population-wide delivery rates. No broad clinical or all-target off-target-safety conclusion follows.
Selected reconstitutions and engineered-cell assays do not establish activity of every mined candidate or native biological function.

Embedding novelty, repertoire descriptors and agent-generated ratings are operational measures. They are not direct proof of biological open-endedness or experimentally realized materials discoveries.
Ratings condition on claim type and documented coverage. All reviewer contexts inherit the same model family. No experiment, raw-data reanalysis or independent reproduction was performed.
